scope: Exploratory cross-suite transfer of the pi0.5 independent-clock deadline condition
order_note: Seed 7 runs 150 -> 175 and seed 8 runs 175 -> 150 to counterbalance endpoint order.

analysis_plan.reporting: descriptive per-suite, per-seed tables with Wilson intervals and paired episode discordance
analysis_plan.cluster_unit: LIBERO task; four episodes within a task are not treated as iid deployment draws
analysis_plan.comparison: compare direction and duty-cycle change with the already preserved Spatial cells
analysis_plan.pooling: do not pool Object and Spatial rollouts into a universal deadline estimate
analysis_plan.multiple_comparisons: do not add further Object deadlines after inspecting these cells

stop_conditions: provider failure, missing inference/simulation overlap, worker not stopped, or validator invalid
checkpoint attestation, OpenPI commit, or runtime source hashes differ from the fixed protocol
less than 60 minutes of server lease remains before starting another cell
do not stop or extend a cell based on an intermediate success rate
claim_boundaries: exploratory transfer to a second LIBERO suite, not a universal threshold
not an official LIBERO leaderboard score
not hardware safety or real-robot deployment evidence
